Kompletan pregled islamske edukativne pl: A complete overview of the Islamic educational platform — what it offers, how it works, and how each role uses learning tools.
Mekteb.net je digitalna islamska edukati: Mekteb.net is a digital Islamic educational platform designed for mekteb instruction, independent learning, and parental progress tracking for children.
Omogućiti svakom djetetu pristup kvalite: To provide every child with access to quality Islamic education regardless of where they live. The platform combines traditional mekteb instruction with modern technology — interactive lessons, quizzes, stories, and educational games that motivate students to learn regularly and with joy.
Sadržaj je usklađen sa suvremenim pedago: Content aligns with modern pedagogical standards: micro-learning (short lessons), visual learning (illustrations and animations), gamification (rewards and games), and differentiated instruction (tailored to age and level of knowledge). Each lesson goes through stages: introduction, content, quiz, and review.
Početna stranica sa pregledom svih modul: Home page with an overview of all modules
Pčela je simbol rada, discipline, zajedn: The bee is a symbol of hard work, discipline, community, and useful knowledge — a perfect example for every student.
U islamskoj tradiciji pčele su spomenute: In Islamic tradition, bees are mentioned in the Qur'an (Surah An-Nahl) as an example of organization, dedication, and usefulness. Our mascot —
— prati učenike kroz cijelu platformu: s: — accompanies students throughout the platform: celebrates achievements, reminds of tasks, encourages at mistakes, and flies across the screen as a curious companion.
Lista kvizova po nivoima sa brojem pitan: List of quizzes by levels with the number of questions and locking status
Životne priče poslanika i islamskih juna: Life stories of prophets and Islamic heroes in chronological order. Each story is illustrated and divided into chapters. The reading room encourages love for Islamic history and role models. Currently 12+ books with multiple chapters.
Knjige u čitaonici sa ilustracijama i st: Books in the reading room with illustrations and reading status
Edukativne igrice koje učenik otključava: Educational games unlocked by time credit earned through honey drops: Remember pair, Quick quiz, Capitals, Flags of the world, Mekteb saće, Honey path, Bee flight, Aferima Table. Each game carries an Aferim as a reward for success. Parent tracks progress and play time.
Modul za učenje arapskog pisma i tedžvid: Module for learning Arabic script and Tajweed. Includes a letter map, interactive lessons and recognition exercises. Currently in development.
Svaka uloga ima specijalizirane alate pr: Each role has specialized tools tailored to its needs—from the student learning, to the parent monitoring progress, to the mu'allim who manages.
Glavni korisnik platforme — uči, rješava: Main platform user — learns, solves quizzes, plays games, and progresses through booster levels.
231 lekcija u 3 nivoa, interaktivna mapa: 231 lessons across 3 levels, interactive journey map, medals and milestones.

Učenje postaje zabava — djeca zarađuju n: Learning becomes fun — children earn rewards through lessons, quizzes and games, while parents monitor progress in real time.
Bodovi za tačne odgovore u kvizovima. Sa: Points for correct answers in quizzes. Collect as many Aferimi as possible and compete with others on the leaderboard.
Postignuti rezultat učenika. Učenik zara: Student achievement. The student earns honey drops by learning lessons and solving quizzes — with them, they earn time for games. The honey drops remain as a permanent achievement.
Pogrešni odgovori se ne brišu — čuvaju s: Wrong answers are not erased — they are kept in the 'jar of mistakes'. The student can later correct each mistake and learn from it.
Svakog dana i svake sedmice učenik dobij: Every day and every week the student receives new challenges — e.g., "Read 3 lessons", "Solve a quiz without mistakes", "Correct 5 mistakes from the jar". Completed missions bring additional rewards.
Igrice nisu beskonačno dostupne — učenik: Games are not endlessly available — the student earns a time credit by learning (through honey drops), and a parent tracks how much time the child spends in games. When the credit runs out, return to learning to earn more.
Svaki nivo (košnica) ima etape — skupove: Each level (hive) has stages — groups of lessons completed by a final exam. After the student passes all stages and the final quiz, the level is "crowned" and the next hive opens.
Pet centralnih modula dostupnih svim kor: Five central modules available to all users, with different access levels depending on the role.

Each lesson combines text, illustrations, audio and H5P interactive elements. Lessons are organized into modules (themes), and the student progresses along a path map with numbers in small circles.
